headline: OGRA has raised the petrol price by Re1 to Rs323 per litre for Friday, November 20, while keeping diesel unchanged at Rs355, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: OGRA ke naye rates Friday, 20 November ke liye

caption:
Petrol Re1 mehnga, nayi qeemat Rs323 fi litre! ⛽
Business Recorder ke mutabiq OGRA ne Thursday ko notification jaari kiya, jis ke mutabiq petrol ki qeemat Rs322 se barh kar Rs323 fi litre ho gayi hai. Diesel ki qeemat Rs355 fi litre par barqarar rahegi. Naye rates Friday, 20 November ke liye hain. Is se pehle petrol kai baar lagataar sasta kiya gaya tha.
Petrol ki nayi qeemat par aap ka kya khayal hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
